Careers

Careers: Acme Pay has built card payment terminals for merchants across Egypt since 2014, and this page describes how the company handles careers for customers and partners.

Every statement here is written by the Acme Pay team in Cairo and reviewed each quarter so that merchants, investors and regulators can rely on the same facts about careers.

If a figure changes during the year, the careers section is updated in place and the date of the change is kept on the page for anyone who needs to check the history.
